name: Tenzo
oneLiner: London-based restaurant reporting and forecasting platform that pulls POS, labor, inventory, reservation and review data into one dashboard.
bestFor: Multi-site restaurant operators in the UK and US that want consolidated performance reporting and AI sales forecasting on top of their existing systems.

updates.text: Raised a $5M first close of a Series A extension led by Edge VC, to double its integrations over 18 months and grow in the US; appointed Jane O'Riordan as board chair.

features: One dashboard for POS sales, labor, inventory, reservations and reviews
Machine learning sales forecasts that factor in weather, holidays and local events
Forecasts pushed into scheduling tools such as Planday and Deputy
Location benchmarking to spot top and underperforming sites
Automated daily and weekly performance reports
MCP connector so teams can query Tenzo data from AI assistants
Large integration library across POS, labor and inventory systems

pricing.text: Custom pricing; Tenzo does not publish prices.

notes: Dropped from current review: 'entry-level plans in the low hundreds per location per month' (no source). '70+ integrations' appears only on a third-party review site (restauranttools.ai), not confirmed on Tenzo's site. Tenzo's '30-50% more accurate than rolling averages' forecast claim is self-reported. Pizza Pilgrims (and Nando's, The Fat Duck) come from a ~2020 Tenzo announcement, so may be dated. Sona integration mentioned by one listing, unverified. MCP connector from gotenzo.com homepage (date not confirmed). Tenzo is analytics/forecasting only, with no inventory counting or recipe costing (third-party review).
